messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Acme Prod just opened an escalation. After last night's 'token-optimizer' rollout their support queries spiked and they sent two examples where the model confidently invented vendor pricing and a nonexistent API endpoint. They're asking for a rollback ASAP.

acme_prod: hey team — here's the customer example. prompt:
```
"What is the monthly cost and endpoint for the Acme Payments SDK v2?"
```
model reply:
```
"Acme Payments SDK v2 costs $79/month per account. Endpoint: https://api.acme.com/v2/payments/create. See pricing section 3.2."
```
(that pricing + endpoint are fabricated; we don't have any v2 or that pricing listed)

maria_cs: customer says this used to be accurate on the previous version — they ran the same prompt pre-rollout and got a cautious "I don't have that info" or a reference to docs. They attached request ids: req-44a1, req-44a2.

ajay_eng: thanks. which model variant was used for those requests?

acme_prod: looks like model: redwood-gen-6b-quantopt (the rolled-out variant). timestamp ~ 2026-02-15T02:12:03Z.

taylor_ml: quick hypothesis: the quantization + tokenizer padding tweak in the optimizer could be skewing prefix handling or truncating context leading to stronger autoregressive completions that guess missing facts. Could also be a fallback routing to a smaller variant for long prompts. Need repro.

maria_cs: customer provided curl repro.
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-6b-quantopt","input":"What is the monthly cost and endpoint for the Acme Payments SDK v2?"}'
```

maria_cs: they included two full responses — both assertive and identical. They say the output is causing support tickets for customers trying the suggested endpoint.

ajay_eng: deploy-bot — can you confirm rollout metadata for redwood-gen-6b-quantopt? commit id, rollout time, and whether fallback routing was enabled?

deploy-bot: rollout redwood-gen-6b-quantopt -> stable at 2026-02-15T01:50Z, commit: b3c9f7e, rollout mode: region-by-region (NA first), fallback: enabled to redwood-gen-6b-std for 429s only. Canary bucket was 5%.

taylor_ml: ok. assign: I will reproduce locally with the quantopt build and the pre-rollout std build, run the customer's exact prompt and a short eval set of 20 prompts that hit knowledge/facts. ajay — can you pull the exact model binary used for those request ids?

ajay_eng: pulling artifacts now. pointers: s3://redwood-artifacts/serving/b3c9f7e/redwood-gen-6b-quantopt.tar.gz. I'll run a quick headless inference to see logits and token probs for that prompt.

maria_cs: customer asked explicitly for rollback if we can confirm regression. They said tickets are flowing to their support queue and they need a mitigation window.

taylor_ml: before rolling back, let's try two immediate mitigations: 1) set routing to prefer redwood-gen-6b-std for requests that match short knowledge-check prompts (heuristic on length / presence of keywords like \"what is\", \"pricing\", \"endpoint\"); 2) throttle the quantopt variant to canary only while we run batch eval. If both easy, we can reduce customer surface area within 30m.

ajay_eng: I can add a temporary routing rule and reduce region traffic for quantopt. Doing it now. Will report when complete.

ajay_eng: routing rule applied — short-knowledge heuristic now routes to redwood-gen-6b-std. quantopt traffic reduced to 2% in NA.

acme_prod: thank you. customer confirms volume dropped and they stopped seeing new fabricated endpoints for the last 15 minutes. They still want root cause and whether previous prompts can be re-verified.

taylor_ml: next steps: I will run repro harness and generate token-level diffs. If quantopt shows higher top-token probability mass for Hallucinatory tokens vs std we have a clear signal. If so, we either patch the optimizer (likely kernel quant step) or revert. I expect results in ~90 minutes.

maria_cs: I opened a support incident with priority high and noted the mitigation steps. Customer asked that we keep them updated every hour. I've tagged them in the incident ticket.

ajay_eng: one more ask — can customer share original pre-rollout outputs for the two request ids? acme_prod: sending as attachments to the ticket.

acme_prod: attaching pre-rollout responses now. Pre-rollout output was non-committal: \"I don't have that version info; please check your account admin or docs.\"

taylor_ml: that contrast is interesting — stronger assertiveness post-rollout implies changed decoding temperature, nucleus, or the model internal tendency. I'll compare sampling params and the logits. If sampling params are identical, it's likely model internals.

maria_cs: action items:
- taylor_ml: reproduce + token diffs + short eval (owner)
- ajay_eng: keep routing mitigations + fetch artifacts (owner)
- maria_cs: keep customer updated hourly + collect any further examples (owner)

ajay_eng: logged rollback option as \"last-resort\" in incident. prefer to patch if it's a quantizer bug. If customer insists after our analysis, we can revert stable to pre-b3c9f7e within service SLA.

maria_cs: thanks all. keep updates in this thread and I'll forward summary to Acme. :white_check_mark:
